scope: Bounded frozen TEST observer delta and current CinderLevel lifecycle review only. No engine, recorder, import, Git, active edit or broad historical review.

byte_delta.finish_change: Only separate disposal diagnostics print; original setups/actions/footer/exit behavior retained.

actual_prior_diagnostic.qualification: Original8/1 and passive diagnostic remain unchanged; these events demonstrate disposal classification, not quiet-restoration or a new native pass.

lifecycle_dependency.construction: enter_restore_candidate sets _entered=true before _on_enter_restore_candidate; constructors and restoring/prepared entered recipients are not eligible for this classifier.
lifecycle_dependency.disposal: exit_level sets _lifecycle_busy=true and _entered=false before _on_exit_level, and clears _restore_candidate after cleanup. is_restore_candidate additionally requires inside-tree and paused.
lifecycle_dependency.installed: finish_restore_candidate clears candidate flag; ordinary old installed epochs cannot qualify.

negative_paths_retained: Invalid/detached emitter, no nearest level, detached level, noncandidate level, entered=true, lifecycle_busy=false or non-Boolean declared flags return null and append the original event kind.

Only ray-phase/lane-phase/cue/cancel are routed to disposal accounting; Ray/Lane hit/defeat and Player input/gear/fired/death/action/action-resolved, Actor defeat and Level CP/completion/exit callbacks retain their original strict _events append.
Original zero-event assertions and full resource/HP/ammo/gear/checkpoint/progress comparisons remain byte-identical; no original damage/hit assertion is removed or reinterpreted.
Actual setup/injury/GUI/controller/route and snapshots, checkpoint/optional/replay/Story/stamp/exit/Leave/retry behavior are unchanged.

Classifier reads lifecycle flags only; it writes no flags/native state and calls no emitter state(), position, transform or world getter. get_instance_id is read only after valid inside-tree classification.
Separate scalar diagnostics retain kind/emitter ID/level ID/flags and supplied scalar values without reconstructing native transforms or repaired snapshots.
classification_limit: This is a lifecycle-scoped separation of presentation/cancel callbacks from genuine nonplayable candidate disposal, not global event suppression or an assertion that all possible disposal payloads are pristine. Actual corrected native result remains Root-owned.
